Check Capital Management Has Lowered Stake in Phillips 66 (PSX) as Share Price Declined; A T & T New (T) Holder Founders Capital Management Has Boosted Its Position
May 16, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
Check Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Phillips 66 (PSX) by 77.35% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Check Capital Management Inc sold 274,869 shares as the company’s stock declined 5.13% with the market. The hedge fund held 80,497 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $8.14 million, down from 355,366 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Check Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Phillips 66 for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $54.55 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.04% or $1.23 during the last trading session, reaching $117.09. About 652,170 shares traded. Phillips 66 (NYSE:PSX) has risen 23.90% since May 16, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 12.35% the S&P500.
Founders Capital Management Llc increased its stake in A T & T Corp New (T) by 5.54% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Founders Capital Management Llc bought 13,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.37% with the market. The institutional investor held 247,667 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.63 million, up from 234,667 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Founders Capital Management Llc who had been investing in A T & T Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $197.80 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.37% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $32.21. About 6.13M shares traded. AT&T Inc. (NYSE:T) has declined 15.88% since May 16, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 27.43% the S&P500.
Founders Capital Management Llc, which manages about $193.00M and $225.87 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Mc Donalds Corp (NYSE:MCD) by 4,107 shares to 14,355 shares, valued at $2.47M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Intl Business Machines (NYSE:IBM) by 28,893 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 7,953 shares, and cut its stake in Lockheed Martin Corp (NYSE:LMT).
